name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a Toronto-based silver-gold development company advancing its 100%-owned Diablillos silver-gold project in Salta province, Argentina. The project is fully permitted and DFS-complete, targeting first production in 2029. The company also holds an earn-in option and joint venture with Teck on the La Coipita project in San Juan province, Argentina.
